messages:
Ana (PM): Heads-up: Crestview asked for a clearly scoped SOC2-ready retention pilot — they want tenant TTLs, an evidence manifest tied to keys, and a BYOK handshake doc. Can we convo this into a scoping decision?
Cody (Eng): Need clarity: tenant TTLs as presets or per-resource TTLs? Also would they expect UI controls + API?
Ana (PM): They want presets exposed in console + API. Priority is quick demo: 90d and 365d presets, and an 'indefinite' option behind an enterprise flag.
Lina (Security): From compliance side: we need immutable evidence pointers, manifest hashing (sha256), and canonical KMS key identifiers. Also require rationale for any off-path retrieval (cold archive).
Mike (SRE): Note: cold-archive retrieval is asynchronous and can be 24-72h depending on load. If we promise audit-search SLOs, we must limit promises to warm window (e.g., last 90d).
Cody (Eng): Proposed minimal pilot scope: 1) Warm audit-search SLO for last 90d (p99 < 700ms), 2) Retention presets (90/365/indefinite) in console + API, 3) Evidence manifest included in audit export with key_id and hash. BYOK handshake deferred to pilot phase 2.
Sara (Legal): For demos/contract milestones we'll need an export manifest that includes custody metadata: {hash, key_id, created_by, retention_selector}. Also add a legal note about limitations and escrow steps for full SOC2 package.
Ana (PM): Can we commit to a pilot for P0 (search + presets + manifest) in 6 weeks limited to 3 customers?
Cody (Eng): 6 weeks is ambitious but doable if scope is narrow: warm-path only, three tenants, no BYOK in pilot. Need support from SRE to allocate warm shards + dedicated query capacity.
Mike (SRE): I'll reserve warm shards and sketch cost. We'll need autoscale guardrails and query throttles to avoid noisy-tenant impact. Also propose rate-limited bulk export pipeline for evidence extraction.
Lina (Security): Action item for me: draft minimal evidence manifest format and canonical KMS key_id mapping rules. We'll require control-plane normalization so manifests don't embed customer-local URIs.
Cody (Eng): Quick acceptance criteria draft for pilot:
- Warm audit-search (90d) p99 < 700ms for tenant-scoped queries.
- Retention presets available in console AND API (90/365/indefinite) with server-side enforcement.
- Audit export includes evidence manifest with sha256 hash and canonical key_id string.
- Pilot limited to 3 enterprise tenants; RBAC enforced; no BYOK (phase 2).
Sara (Legal): Add: export manifest must include statement of custody and a signed note of limitations for pilot. We'll prepare a 1-page amendment.
Ana (PM): ops-bot
open a ticket and assign to Eng. Cody, Mike, Lina, Sara
please add docs to the ticket.
ops-bot: New task created - PRODUCT-5019: Pilot: Warm audit-search + retention presets + export manifest (assignee: Cody). Due date: 2026-06-12.
Cody (Eng): I'll post a spec doc to the ticket by Friday EOD. It will include index schema: tenant_id, event_type, ts, retention_tier, evidence_pointer, hash, key_id.
Mike (SRE): I'll attach an infra cost estimate and autoscaling plan. Considering a dedicated query pool and 2x warm shards per tenant for pilot traffic patterns.
Lina (Security): I'll attach manifest spec and list of audit artifacts required for phase 2 (BYOK escrow, immutable proofs, KMS escrow runbook).
Sara (Legal): I'll draft the contract amendment for the pilot limitations and a checklist of items needed for full SOC2 evidence.
Ana (PM): Thanks all. I'll update the roadmap and confirm scope with Crestview. We'll treat BYOK + KMS escrow as P1 deliverable after pilot success.
Cody (Eng): Noted. Posting follow-up with more granular work breakdown.
Ana (PM): Closing thread; moving actions into PRODUCT-5019. :white_check_mark:
